run_copy_dataset_info_files: run the script to copy dataset info files from a source directory to a GCS bucket destination
run_copy_dataset_info_files_dry_run: run the script in dry-run mode to preview which dataset info files would be copied without making changes
run_copy_dataset_info_files_overwrite: run the script with overwrite enabled to replace existing dataset info files at the destination
run_copy_dataset_info_files_custom_dirs: run the script copying dataset info files from a custom source directory to a custom destination directory
summarize_copy_function: summarize the copy function that iterates over dataset full names and copies metadata files to a target directory
